verdict.rationale: Azure is a cloud platform that hosts customer data and offers AI services, so a data-training opt-out or no-training guarantee is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has nothing on AI training data use, opt-out controls, or data-use policies; it covers only the CLI, IaC, RBAC, cost management and outages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
